thread:
Lin: Quick postmortem follow-up 3 we're still seeing a recurring pattern of TLS handshake retries on cross-region flows (edge -> us-west-2 -> eu-central). Root postmortem live, but creating an action/ownership thread for remediation + verifications. Key symptoms: intermittent SNI mismatch errors, backend route flaps under high fanout, and elevated retry counts from clients behind our global LB.

Maya: Can you paste the most recent symptom logs? Is this limited to a subset of customers or broad? :eyes:

Lin: Logs attached in the PM doc. Primary signal is TLS alert 40 followed by connection resets. It looks intermittent and correlated with region failovers and certain route table updates. Affected flows are ~8% of requests to a small number of prefixes (carrier/edge combos) 3 not a broad outage but recurring and noisy.

Sam: Hypothesis: a timing window where edge LB updates SNI mapping but old routes still active in downstream proxies. If the client hits a proxy with stale config we get SNI mismatch -> handshake retry -> client retries and hits another region (cascade). Could also be config propagation order bug in the route deploy pipeline.

Anita: I can own the SNI/DNS mapping audit. I'll run a sweep across all LB config revisions for the last 30 days and compare server_name->backend mappings. Will also validate K8s Ingress SNI annotations where present. ETA 48h for initial audit.

Lin: Thanks @anita. Please check both stash-based deploy and live config; add any mismatches to the remediation spreadsheet. I added a tracker: https://redwood-internal/pm/194777 (PM link).

Maya: For mitigations: can we add an automatic fallback to a compatible model (i.e., accept both old/new SNI during rollout) or deploy canary where config flips at edges first?

Sam: Short-term mitigation options:
- Add a short-lived SNI alias on servers for the old name while we roll out (cheap)
- Force a sequenced deploy: update edges -> verify -> update region proxies -> update origin
- Add a circuit-breaker to reduce fanout when TLS retries spike so we don't cascade
I'll prototype an edge-first deploy playbook.

Anita: Action list I'm taking now:
- Audit mapping (owner: anita) 3 due: +48h
- Generate list of LB config versions with SNI changes (owner: anita) 3 due: +48h
- Validate Ingress/K8s annotations (owner: anita) 3 due: +48h

Lin: Ops tasks I want assigned:
- Deploy playbook for sequenced rollout + SNI alias option (owner: sam) 3 due: +5d
- Add circuit-breaker rule to LB to throttle retry-driven fanout (owner: maya) 3 due: +3d
- Add a short-lived alert for TLS alert 40 rate increase + cross-region retry spike (owner: lin) 3 due: +24h

ops-bot: New task created: #INC-4721 "SNI mapping audit for cross-region TLS retries" assigned to anita, due 48h.

Maya: I'll spin up a guardrail in the LB rule engine today to cap retry amplification. Will post the change and rollback plan in the policy PR.

Sam: Repro steps I used in staging to trigger the handshake mismatch (share in case helpful):
```
# openssl to test SNI servername
openssl s_client -connect lb-staging.redwood.io:443 -servername example-old.svc.redwood.io
# reproduce DNS resolution path used by our edge agents
dig +short @8.8.8.8 edge-us-west1.lb.redwood.io
# quick smoke from an origin proxy to see active cert names
curl -vk --resolve lb-staging.redwood.io:443:35.201.1.2 https://lb-staging.redwood.io/
```
Use these to confirm whether the server accepts the old SNI alias.

Anita: Logged a few mismatches already 3 will push a CSV to the tracker. If mappings differ across regions that's a high priority.

Lin: Governance note: please include any change that keeps dual SNI support in the rollback matrix and schedule a canary for low-traffic tenant first. Also add a note in the release notes for Dedicated customers: possible transient 5xx on cross-region requests during fix windows.

Maya: Quick question 3 do we have telemetry on per-prefix retry amplification? If not, adding one would help quantify impact.

Lin: We have token-level retry counters but not per-prefix. Ops, can we add a label dimension to the retry metric? If it's cheap, do it as part of the +24h alerts item.

ops-bot: Metric augmentation request recorded: #MET-1988 "retry_count by prefix label" assigned to eng-infra, priority P2.

Sam: I'll draft the deployment playbook and post as a PR in infra-playbooks by EOD tomorrow. It will include: pre-checks, edge-first sequenced rollout, SNI alias toggle, and automated verification scripts.

Anita: I'll schedule a 30m sync after the audit results (48h) to review severe mismatches and finalize owners for rollouts. Who should join? I suggest lin, sam, maya, one infra oncall.

Lin: Add @ops-oncall and @security as optional. Confirming daily check-ins for the next 5 business days at 09:30 PT 3 I'll post the calendar invite.

incident-bot: Summary appended to incident timeline: "SNI/TLS retry pattern 3 owners assigned (anita/sam/maya), audit due +48h, mitigations drafted. Follow-ups scheduled."

Maya: Noted. I'll post the LB rule diff here once created. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Lin: Closing loop 3 we'll reconvene after audit. If anyone hits a fast-path fix, DM me first before sweeping deploys.
